walkthroughs.body_html:
Area B: Personal and Social Life — a core area of GCSE Spanish.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Area B: Personal and Social Life brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Area B: Personal and Social Life.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Which sentence means 'Maths is more difficult than English'?
options: Las matemáticas son más difíciles que el inglés.
Las matemáticas es más difícil que el inglés.
Las matemáticas son menos difíciles que el inglés.
Las matemáticas más difícil que el inglés son.

mcqs.q: What is the Spanish word for 'mobile phone' (in Spain)?
options: El móvil.
El telefon.
El celular (which is used in Latin America).

mcqs.q: How do you say 'My sister is embarrassed' in Spanish?
options: Mi hermana es embarazo.
Mi hermana está embarazada.
El telefon.
Mi hermana tiene vergüenza / está avergonzada.
It only means 'his brother'.
It means 'a brother' (indefinite).
El telefon.
Could be his/her/your(formal)/their brother - context determines which.
